description: Calculate a natal astrology chart: Sun, Moon and rising sign (the big three), Venus, Mars, Saturn and North Node signs, each with a short approved meaning, plus a link to the matching free tool page. Use when someone asks "what's my rising sign", "my big three", "what's my Moon sign", "my Venus sign", "my birth chart" or "what sign is my Mars in". Positions come from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, so never guess a sign from a birthday alone. birth_time and birth_place are optional: without the time the Moon may show two possible signs and there is no rising sign; the rising sign needs the time and a listed birthplace (or latitude and longitude).

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.

name: get_birth_chart
title: Birth chart: Sun, Moon, rising
